title: Security Insights: Monitor your Data Center security posture
description:
Organization admins can now monitor the security posture of their self-managed instances directly from Atlassian Administration. The new Security Insights dashboard in Portfolio Insights provides aggregated security signals and metrics, helping you identify and address vulnerabilities across your environment. To get started with this change: Log in to admin.atlassian.com.
	Select your organization, then go to Portfolio Insights or Insights.
